name: quality testing strategy
rules: Design regression-first tests that cover behavior, boundaries, invalid input and evidence integrity.
Prefer deterministic fixtures and isolate external or unavailable dependencies.
Keep test success distinct from unverified assumptions and preserve meaningful failure diagnostics.
verification: Review changed behavior for unit, integration, contract, architecture and negative-path coverage.
Run focused tests followed by the applicable quality gate and inspect the resulting evidence.

provided_capabilities.description: Design deterministic regression coverage for changed behavior
